**Sandy's Sock Hop**, also known as **Sandy's Saturday Night Sock Hop** [1] is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

- Sandy (Owner)
- Moezart and the Tops (Performing Band) [2] 
- Danny (Guest) [2] 
- Tommy (Guest) [2] 
- Sophie (Guest) [2] 
- Valerie (Guest) [2] 
- Cassie (Guest) [2] 
- Joey (Guest) [2] 
- Rust Raider

(equipment used by the Business)

- One Abraxodyne Intel, behind the counter inside the building.
- If I can Dance with Danny - Note, next to two skeletons on the floor, left of the stage.

Sandy's Sock Hop appears in *Fallout 76*.
